approval.note: A composed script is a draft. A human reads it before this film is published anywhere.

script.vo01: Procurement documents are written from scratch each time, and consistency depends on who has the previous version. Checking a vendor invoice against its purchase order is slow work, and the supporting paperwork is rarely in one place.
script.vo02: Errors surface late, after the payment has moved.
script.vo03: It reads Procurement and tender documents, Vendor invoices and purchase orders. It engages you in Microsoft 365 Copilot and SharePoint. And it can generate a procurement document from the approved structure, showing the reasoning behind every answer.
script.vo04: A procurement lead asks for a tender pack. The agent builds it from the approved structure, pulls the clauses this contract type requires, and lists what is still missing.
script.vo05: Asked about evaluation, the agent sets out the criteria in order, explains the weighting it has assumed, and marks the ones the evaluation panel must set itself.
script.vo06: On risk, the agent compares the vendor's invoices with their purchase orders, shows where the lines diverge, and points to the supporting document behind each mismatch.
script.vo_payoff: Procurement teams produce the document sooner and see the invoice mismatch before the payment moves.
script.vo_helps: The result? A compliant document produced sooner, consistent invoice checking, and fewer errors from paperwork nobody can find.
script.vo_cta: Get started on your agentic journey today. Talk to your Microsoft representative to learn more.
